column1: # The one icon list. Columns (tab separated):
#   AppIcon entry | Material Symbol (outlined, at rest) | Material Symbol drawn filled ("=" same name, "-" none) |
#   SF Symbol (at rest) | SF Symbol filled ("-" none) | directional (mirrors in RTL)
# "custom" marks an icon the app draws itself (the Waves dash); its SF column is the system stand-in for places that
# need a symbol name (widgets, labels). Material Symbols: Apache 2.0 (see NOTICE). SF Symbols: iOS 17 or older only.
